product_metadata.title: GRIPTULA Multipurpose Slotted Spatula for Nonstick Cookware – Heat Resistant All-In-One Wide Egg Turner, Cooking Tongs & Pancake Flipper with Silicone Edge – Clever Spatula Tongs (Cyan)
features: ULTIMATE KITCHEN UTENSIL: Do you want to mix, fold, sauté, stir, grab, flip, and serve your foods - fast and easy - with no mess? Introducing the Griptula - a revolutionary all-in-one meat spatula, cooking tongs, silicone turner, and flipper. Flip, grip, and lift your favorite food from pan to plate with no more spills!

MAKE COOKING EFFORTLESS: Why have multiple utensils cluttering your drawers, when you can have one slotted spatula for nonstick cookware that does it all. Enjoy perfect flips on your Sunday morning pancakes. Get a quick turn on your grilled cheese sandwich or tortilla - it won’t fall apart! Get the most versatile tool in your kitchen now.

HEAT-RESISTANT: Do you want heat resistant spatulas for cooking indoors? Our nonstick spatula handles a sizzling pan with no scratches. Scoop up veggies, take fries out the fryer, turn omelets with precision - nothing stands in the way of the Griptula!

EASY TO USE, CLEAN & STORE: This slotted turner has silicone handle for maximum comfort. It rests on the edge of your pan, leaving no mess on your counter. And clean-up? Effortless by hand and dishwasher safe. Having one multi-usage tool is perfect, saving you money, time and free up drawer space. Plus, the Griptula is more compact than regular tongs.

MIX, GRIP, FLIP & SERVE: Flip steak then grab and serve veggies at the push of a button - it’s so flippin’ easy! Slippy veggies won’t slide out the Griptula egg turner spatula on route to the plate. Silicone edges give extra protection on non-stick cookware. Plus it’s non-toxic and BPA-free.
description: Picture it now. You’re in your kitchen. Utensils misplaced everywhere. Your favorite food simmering away. In the heat of the moment, you end up using a fork as your kitchen spatula and bare hands as your cooking tongs. Sound familiar? We have an incredible way to leave all your kitchen cooking calamities in the past. With our 2 in 1 spatula tong, you can forget about all your other utensils - you won’t be needing them. You can flip your pancakes, mix your stir-fries, fold your omelets, grab hold of your sausages, and sauté your fresh vegetables.

Have you had a tough time with silicone spatulas in the past? Our nylon/silicone cooking master tool - suitable for all cookware - is heat resistant and the silicone handle is contoured for extra comfort; it molds into your hand like a glove as it manipulates your food to do whatever you want.
Mix, Grip & Flip Your Way to Cooking Mastery

Are you ready to discover the rosetta stone of cooking utensils? After one use of our cookware friendly, silicone edge spatula, you can begin to declutter your cupboards. You will have a turner, tong, flipper, and wide spatula ready to cook all your favorite dishes. With the press of a button, you can grab a firm hold of your veggies, press again and you can go right back to flipping and mixing - a slotted turner utensil you’ll never want to put down.
When you’re finished, put it inside your dishwasher or wash it by hand; it will return sparkling clean every time. Let's get cooking, shall we?
Press ‘Add To Cart’ now and experience a cooking revolution!
